thread:
sara: FYI customer MapleHealth is seeing repeated 429s + big tail latency on their Dedicated pool (us-west-2-dedicated-2) since ~08:09 UTC. They report request spikes then immediate throttles, and retries. sample error from customer: "status=429, reason=throttle_quota". Can oncall take a look? :pray:

oliver: on it. can you attach the autoscaler event stream and any recent deploys for that pool? also which model they were hitting?

autoscale-bot: [autoscaler events]
08:08:56 pool=us-west-2-dedicated-2 metric=cpu_utilization=78% target_replicas=4 action=scale_up id=ev-8792
08:09:40 pool=us-west-2-dedicated-2 metric=queue_latency_p95=620ms target_replicas=4 action=scale_up id=ev-8793
08:11:12 pool=us-west-2-dedicated-2 metric=cpu_utilization=22% target_replicas=2 action=scale_down id=ev-8797
08:12:03 pool=us-west-2-dedicated-2 metric=cpu_utilization=85% target_replicas=4 action=scale_up id=ev-8801
(note: rapid up/down in ~3m window)

maria: looks like classic oscillation. customer said most calls are to model "redwood-open-7b-q4" pinned to that pool. I ran quick repro from lab by hammering 40 concurrent short requests and saw the same pattern: pool scales up, then down, then up again. paste of reproducer: 

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REPRO_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b-q4","input":"token test","max_tokens":16}' &
(repeat 40x in parallel)

Observed response headers: "x-rewood-pool: us-west-2-dedicated-2" and intermittent "x-rewood-error: throttle_quota".

cheng: two likely contributors: 1) reactive scaler uses short window (30s) and immediate scale_down when utilization drops between spikes, 2) no smoothing for p95 queue latency. when load is bursty we see push-pull. propose: increase scale_up cooldown and add smoothing on the latency metric. patch suggestion: 

```
# autoscaler config (proposal)
scale_up_cooldown: 180s
scale_down_cooldown: 240s
smoothing_window_seconds: 60
hysteresis_fraction: 0.12
max_scale_step: 2
```

This should prevent the quick down after a transient drop and cap the step-size.

oliver: agree. short-term mitigation: disable aggressive downscaling for that pool (set scale_down_cooldown=900s) to buy time for config rollout, and throttle the pool's per-customer concurrency to limit noisy neighbor impact. I'll do a canary config on the pool.

maria: also found some noisy-model behavior: one tenant (internal loadtest) was hitting the same pool with constant 50-100 token streams. I paused that job which immediately reduced churn. worth checking tenant isolation.

oliver: action plan:
- roll canary autoscaler config to us-west-2-dedicated-2 (maria, cheng)
- temporarily increase scale_down_cooldown to 900s for that pool (oliver)
- apply smoothing_window_seconds=60 and max_scale_step=2 (cheng)
- throttle per-tenant concurrency and notify customer of ongoing work (sara)
- monitor p95 and 429s for 30m, roll back if visible regressions

maria: rolling the canary now. PR: https://internal.redwood/infra/prs/4521 (canary: autoscaler/patch-1792). will also create a short repro playbook in runbook repo.

oncall-bot: INC-4521 created and linked to this thread. severity=sev3. Escalation: eng-platform.

oliver: deployed temporary scale_down_cooldown=900s on pool us-west-2-dedicated-2 at 08:27 UTC. will watch.

sara: told MapleHealth we are investigating and paused internal loadtest; asked them to hold traffic for 20m while we monitor. they appreciate the quick response. :thumbsup:

maria: initial metrics look better after pause and canary starting to stabilize p95. will confirm at 08:40 and then promote if stable.

cheng: long-term follow-ups: tune autoscaler smoothing per-pool based on workload burstiness, add per-tenant soft caps, and add an "avoid-flapping" mode that increases hysteresis when frequent scale events detected. filing engineering ticket.

oliver: thanks team. keep updates in thread and paste any errors here. if 429s spike again, we'll open an incident.

sara: customer updated at 08:38 UTC, reduced 429s, asked for post-mortem. I'll draft a short RCA and include mitigation steps and the repro playbook.

maria: PR merged to canary, will promote to global after 30m of stable metrics.

cheng: filing meta ticket: INFRA-2109 (autoscaler: per-pool smoothing & flapping detection).

oncall-bot: Note: alert suppression enabled for ev-8792..ev-8801 to avoid noisy alerts during config change.
